output.notes:
Describes full Primer as defined in Sec. 3: squared ReLU, MDHA (causal 3x1 depthwise conv after the K and V projections), shared QK (Q = K W), norm before attention and after the FFN, and the custom layernorm. The 12X bottleneck, post-softmax spatial gating and extraneous modifications are excluded, as the paper says. The 1.9B one-shot Primer drops shared QK; in that case Q gets its own MDHA projection. Primer-EZ (the paper's recommended starting point) is plain Transformer + squared ReLU + MDHA.

The FFN norm is modelled as branch_post, x + norm(FFN(x)), following the program listing (lines 44-53). The listing also has a doubled residual add, a tanh after the softmax and -1.12 constant multiplies; these are treated as the excluded extraneous no-ops.

The 1.9B dimensions are quoted from the baseline description; Primer is compared at the same 1.9B configuration. Heads, vocab, eps, biases and tying are not stated. Base-Transformer details otherwise follow each codebase's defaults, which are unstated.
